bullets.title: Be Light, Be lively
bullets.text: Recreating the first popular item of the Weaving+ series "Sunset Moment", we have woven an immersive blue time from sunset to moonrise.

bullets.title: Premium Wave
bullets.text: Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, our case offers a silky-smooth, luxurious texture you can feel. It's not just light and strong — it's a pleasure to hold, every single time.

bullets.title: Pitatap
bullets.text: A case under 1 mm thick shields the Camera Control Button with aramid fiber, while a hidden capacitive layer lets you tap and slide effortlessly. Seamlessly integrated, it preserves the aramid texture for precise, responsive control.

bullets.title: Paper Thin & Feather Light
bullets.text: Offers a sleek, barely-there profile that preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists seeking elegant protection without added weight.

26249.name: PITAKA iPhone 17 Pro Edge Case (600D Black/Grey-Twill)

bullets.title: Aerospace-Grade Aramid Strength
bullets.text: Made from aerospace-grade aramid fiber, which is 5x stronger than steel and weighs just 1/5 as much. It's ultra-thin, incredibly tough, and built for premium protection — without the bulk.

bullets.title: Hi-Res Audio
bullets.text: Featuring custom 40mm dynamic drivers, soundcore Q11i Bluetooth Headphones deliver Hi-Res sound when connected using the included AUX cable.

bullets.title: One-Touch Bass Boost
bullets.text: With BassUp technology, simply press the BassUp button to instantly boost the bass. Perfect for genres like EDM and hip-hop, it ensures deeper, more powerful bass to create an immersive experience.

bullets.title: 60-Hour Playtime
bullets.text: Enjoy up to 60 hours of playtime with soundcore Q11i Bluetooth Headphones. A quick 5-minute charge gives you an extra 4 hours of listening, so you can stay in the groove for longer.

bullets.title: Detachable Ear Cushions
bullets.text: Easily detach and replace soundcore Q11i's ear cushions.

bullets.title: Note
bullets.text: soundcore Q11i Bluetooth Headphones do not feature active noise cancelling (ANC).

bullets.title: Powerful 7-in-1 Hub
bullets.text: Designed for the multitasker, this 7-in-1 USB-C hub features everything from ultra-fast data transfer to high-definition video output.

bullets.title: See More, Do More
bullets.text: Easily extend your workspace across two screens with 1080p@60Hz resolution, ideal for enhancing productivity and multitasking capabilities.

bullets.title: Blazing-Fast 10Gbps Data Transfer
bullets.text: Dramatically reduce transfer times with a 10Gbps port that quickly moves large files and boosts work productivity.

bullets.title: 100W Fast Charging
bullets.text: Cut down on charging time with the powerful 100W input and 85W output, suitable for all your high-demand technology. (Note: Wall charger not included.)

bullets.title: Compatibility
bullets.text: Supports USB-C, USB4, and Thunderbolt connections. Compatible with MacBook (macOS 12 and newer), Windows 10 and 11, ChromeOS, and laptops equipped with DP Alt Mode and Power Delivery. Note: This device is not compatible with Linux.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker USB-C Hub (7-in-1, Dual Display), welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: The Only Charger You Need
bullets.text: Say goodbye to your old chargers. Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W) has the power you need to fast charge your phone, tablet, and USB-C notebook from a single charger.

bullets.title: High-Speed Charging
bullets.text: Connect a single device to get a 65W max charge — that's enough to power up a 2020 MacBook Pro 13″ at full speed. And when you connect three devices, power will be distributed efficiently between ports to ensure you get the best charge.

bullets.title: Compact Design
bullets.text: Power up to 3 devices with a charger that's roughly the size of an AirPods Pro case.

bullets.title: Powered by GaN II Technology
bullets.text: With a 100% increase in operating frequency, an innovative stacked design, and an upgraded circuit board structure, GaN II technology makes our latest charger smaller without sacrificing a drop of power.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W) / PowerPort III 3-Port 65W Pod, welcome guide, our worry-free 12-month warranty, and friendly customer service.

bullets.title: 6-in-1 Charger for All
bullets.text: Designed for modern needs, this charger can power your entire digital lineup, from laptops to smartphones, all at the same time. Note: 30W charging is limited to the USB-C1 port for MacBook Air.

bullets.title: Maximum Power, Minimum Time
bullets.text: Efficiently power your MacBook Air to 50% in just 1 hour 40 minutes or quickly boost your iPhone 16 Pro Max from 0 — 50% in 30 minutes with a single 30W max charging port.

bullets.title: 112W Multi-Device Charger
bullets.text: Equipped with 3 USB-C and 3 USB-A ports, this charger offers a total output of 112W, making it powerful enough to charge a range of devices.

bullets.title: Tidy Desk, Tidy Mind
bullets.text: Say goodbye to tangled wires and cluttered desks. Included with the charger is a silicone cable organizer, ensuring your workspace remains orderly and stress-free.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Charger (112W, 6 Ports), cable organizer, welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

26735.name: Zolo Power Bank (10K, 35W, Built-in Dual USB-C Cables)

bullets.title: Dual Cables Built-In
bullets.text: Charge effortlessly with dual built-in cables, including Dual USB-C cable. These cables are tested to last over 10,000 bends for long-lasting use.

bullets.title: 35W High-Speed Charging
bullets.text: Enjoy more time on the go without waiting around for your devices to charge with 35W power. Boost an iPhone 15 to 58% or a Samsung S24 to 53% in just 30 minutes.

bullets.title: 10,000mAh Portable Power
bullets.text: Perfect for travel, this compact power bank weighs only 7.65 oz. It provides 2 full charges for an iPhone 15, keeping your adventures powered without the bulk.

bullets.title: Charge 4 Devices at Once
bullets.text: Enjoy multi-device charging anywhere with Dual built-in USB-C, a USB-C port, and a USB-A port.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Zolo Power Bank (10K, Built-In 2 x USB-C), welcome guide.

26758.name: Nano Power Bank (10K, 45W, Built-In Retractable USB-C Cable)

bullets.title: Your Go-To Power Solution
bullets.text: Features a 10,000mAh capacity, 45W max fast charging, pass-through technology, a smart display, and 24/7 battery protection for safe, efficient power. The USB-C port and included cable support 40W fast charging for the iPhone 16 series and Samsung.

bullets.title: Sleek and Portable
bullets.text: Designed for life on the go, this power bank is 16% smaller than standard models with a retractable cable, making it easy to carry. Plus, it is flight-approved.

bullets.title: Two-Way Fast Charging
bullets.text: Enjoy simultaneous charging and recharging with a 45W max single-port USB-C output for devices and a 30W max input for quick power bank replenishment. Charge an iPhone 16 Pro to 50% in 27 minutes and recharge the power bank to 100% in 2 hours.

bullets.title: Pull, Adjust, and Charge
bullets.text: Seamlessly power up with a pull of the durable, built-in retractable cable, capable of over 20,000 bends. Charge neatly and efficiently without the hassle of tangled wires.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Zolo Power Bank (10K, Built-In USB-C and Lightning Cable), 1 ft USB-C to USB-C cable, welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

26785.name: Network Video Recorder S4 for Home Security Cameras

bullets.title: Local AI Agent
bullets.text: Unlock proactive, real-time security with our local AI agent, fueled by 6T/8-Core power for instant analysis, genuine threat identification, and decisive action. Customize no-go zones and alerts, enabling AI to accurately detect real danger and ensure tailored responses.

bullets.title: Free Smart Video Search
bullets.text: Instead of scrolling through all of your videos, instantly find what you're looking for by searching keywords.

bullets.title: Expandable Security
bullets.text: Start with 8-channel surveillance and easily expand to 16 as needed. Includes a pre-installed 2 TB HDD (upgradeable to 16 TB) for 24/7 recording and lasting peace of mind.

bullets.title: Plug and Play
bullets.text: Just one network cable connects each eufy PoE camera to the NVR for power and video, making setup a breeze — even for beginners!

bullets.title: Wide Compatibility
bullets.text: Works with other eufy security cameras (Wi-Fi module required), ensuring seamless integration with your existing security setup. Compatible with Alexa and Google Assistant.

bullets.title: Only for eufy Cameras
bullets.text: Designed exclusively for eufy cameras to ensure optimal performance and integration.

bullets.title: Effortless Remote Control
bullets.text: Experience AI-powered remote access with eufy NVR S4 for smarter 24/7 surveillance, supporting up to 16 eufy cameras (PoE, plug-in Wi-Fi, or battery-powered Wi-Fi) and flexible streaming.

bullets.title: Expandable Security, Effortless Setup
bullets.text: Supports up to 8 Bullet‑PTZ Cams (uses 2 channels each) or up to 16 Bullet/Turret Cams. 8‑channel surveillance expandable to 16. Includes a pre‑installed 2 TB HDD (upgradeable to 16 TB) for 24/7 recording. Plug‑and‑play design with a single PoE cable for both power and video, making eufy camera and smart assistant integration seamless.
